project.title: The Message
project.source_text:
Andre Athar sits at a small wooden desk in a quiet apartment and lowers his eyes toward a folded note.

At the glass doorway, Andre looks back toward the room. His off-screen voice says: Not again.

Optional cafe coverage study: an empty industrial cafe; Andre sits by the window and glances at a folded note, then looks toward the counter without speaking.

style_bible.look: Live-action cinematic realism, quiet natural daylight
camera_rules: One small action per shot. Keep camera still.

shots.subject: Andre Athar
shots.action: Andre sits at a small wooden desk along the left wall. A folded white paper note rests on the desk. His face stays visible in a gentle three-quarter view. He lowers his eyes toward the note once, keeping his body still.

shots.subject: Andre Athar
shots.action: Andre already stands inside the closed glass doorway, torso angled toward it. He slowly turns his head toward the room once, showing a gentle three-quarter face with quiet resignation. His body remains still.

shots.subject: Industrial cafe
shots.action: A static view of the empty cafe, espresso counter at left foreground and window table at right. No people enter.

shots.subject: Andre Athar
shots.action: Andre sits at the round window table. A folded white note lies on the table. He lowers his eyes toward it once; his lips remain gently together and his face is neutral.

shots.subject: Andre Athar
shots.action: Andre remains seated at the same round window table, seen from the reverse-counter angle. He looks toward the counter once, with relaxed closed lips and a neutral face. He does not speak.
